etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin explanatio (“an explanation, interpretation”), from explanare (“explain”); see explain. Morphologically explain +‎ -ation. Displaced native Old English racu.

definitions.definition: The act or process of explaining.
A resolution of disputed points pursuant to discussion; a mutual clarification of disputed points; reconciliation.

quote.citation: 1815, Jane Austen, Emma, volume III, chapter 3:
quote.text: This little explanation with Mr. Knightley gave Emma considerable pleasure.
